verdict.rationale: Orama's first-party docs say every Orama Cloud project comes with an automatically configured MCP server, so agents in AI interfaces like ChatGPT and Cursor can work with project data. A probe confirms a dedicated MCP Server docs page, also listed in llms.txt. missing for 10: details of the exposed tools, auth and connection setup, any MCP support for the open-source library (it is Cloud-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
